title: PLA 1.1.1 first-pass Pokédex semantic annotations

source.evidence_scope: static Ghidra C pseudocode, strings and direct call evidence only

naming_policy: Suggested names are annotations, not original symbols. Do not apply them as confirmed names until caller/callee, data layout and runtime side effects are closed.
